item.title: Uwajima Ushioni Festival — Guide
item.description: The Uwajima Ushioni Festival is the great summer celebration of the southern city of Uwajima, held in late July. Its unmistakable symbol is the ushioni or ‘sea ox’, a fantastical monster float several metres long with a body draped in red cloth or palm fibre, a long neck, and a fierce demon-like head, carried by teams of young people who make it lunge, sway and ‘battle’ through the streets to drive away evil spirits and pray for good health.
